LanguageData.GM21_Med_ModeCureDesc: Target a living patient and cure one pathological condition that ordinary medicine cannot properly address - diseases, chronic illness, food poisoning. Wounds, missing parts, implants, pregnancy and unknown conditions are never offered.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_ModeReconstructDesc: Target a living patient and restore one missing natural body part. A part already replaced by a bionic, prosthetic or implant is never offered.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_ModeResuscitateDesc: Target a recently dead, medically viable corpse and bring the pawn back to life. The body must be fresh, its brain and vital anatomy intact, and the work must begin within four hours of death. Wounds are preserved and stabilised, not erased.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_NotPractising: {0} cannot practise Grandmaster medicine right now (needs consciousness and manipulation).
LanguageData.GM21_Med_NotSelf: A Grandmaster cannot perform this intervention on themselves.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_NotOurPatient: {0} is not under the colony's care. Only colony members, prisoners of the colony, or downed pawns can be treated.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_NoCureCandidates: {0} has no condition Grandmaster Cure can safely address. Wounds are treated by ordinary tending; missing parts by Reconstruct.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_NoReconstructCandidates: {0} has no missing natural anatomy that can be reconstructed.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_ConditionGone: The condition is no longer present.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_NoLongerCurable: {0} is no longer a condition Grandmaster Cure can address.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_NoLongerReconstructable: The body part can no longer be safely reconstructed.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_ResUnavailable: This body cannot be reached for resuscitation.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_ResNotFlesh: Only flesh bodies can be resuscitated.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_ResSupernatural: This is not a medical death.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_ResHostile: A hostile body cannot be resuscitated safely.
LanguageData.GM21_Med_TreatmentRecovery: Grandmaster Treatment ({0}): this injury recovers x{1} faster
LanguageData.GM21_Med_TreatmentImmunity: Grandmaster Treatment ({0}): immunity to this disease develops x{1} faster
